WEBSITE CARD · LaCasa
ITEM: Smart door lock
ROOM: Entrance
QUANTITY: 1
BUDGET: Not specified
DEADLINE: Tell contractor by 11 Nov
SALES WORTH WAITING FOR: 11.11 and Black Friday expected; lock-specific offers unconfirmed
10-SECOND ANSWER: Pursue Aqara U400 for hands-free Apple entry with fingerprint backup. Confirm Apple devices, door fit and ready stock before paying.
SUMMARY: Compared U400 hands-free entry against the cheaper U100 fingerprint and tap-to-unlock alternative. U400 matches the requested experience; U100 is the cheaper compromise.
PRICE TIERS: Budget about S$400–500 installed · Mid about S$600–700 installed · Splurge S$850+
MUST KNOW: U400 needs suitable Apple equipment | No door handle included | Ready stock unverified | Test actual approach route
CONTRACTOR NEEDS TO KNOW: Assess existing lock and handle | Check door thickness and backset | Use manufacturer drilling template | Check frame, gate clearance and applicable approvals
FULL REPORT: None

OPTION A
Name: Aqara U400 wooden-door kit
Tier: Mid
Planned price: S$649 installed, plus Apple hub if needed and any door alterations
Headline: Unlock with your phone still pocketed
Why you'll love it: Approach entry with fingerprint available as backup.
Watch out: Approach reliability varies; ready stock and door fit remain unverified.
Best for: Your requested hands-free Apple setup.
Pros: Hands-free entry | Fingerprint backup | Automatic locking
Cons: Apple equipment required | Rechargeable battery needs attention | Door alterations may cost extra
Owners say: Useful but approach-sensitive; one critical owner improved results by changing approach height (https://www.reddit.com/r/Aqara/comments/1qehpgm/i_wanted_to_like_the_aqara_u400/, January 2026)
Where to buy: Harvey Norman · S$649 installed · stock unverified · checked 2026-10-23 · https://www.harveynorman.com.sg/smart-tech-and-phones/smart-home/smart-security/aqara-u400-smart-door-lock-kit-with-installation-timber-door-black-dl-d06d.html | HomeSmart · S$469–849 across variants, exact installed variant price to confirm · stock unverified · checked 2026-10-23 · https://homesmart.sg/product/aqara-u400-smart-lock-kit/
Buy timing: Wait for door assessment; target S$649 or less installed with written onsite support.
Reliability confidence: Limited — mixed ownership reports and less than one year of model history.

OPTION B
Name: Aqara U100 installed kit
Tier: Budget
Planned price: S$499 installed, subject to stock and fit
Headline: Fingerprint entry for S$150 less
Why you'll love it: Fingerprint and Apple tapping at a lower listed installation price.
Watch out: It cannot provide U400 hands-free approach unlocking.
Best for: Choosing to save money and accepting touch or tap entry.
Pros: Lower listed price | Replaceable AA batteries | Apple Home Key
Cons: No hands-free UWB | Separate handle required | Ready stock unverified
Owners say: Older owners reported idle chiming and battery drain; replies did not establish a universal fix (https://www.reddit.com/r/Aqara/comments/14ec7a5/u100_keeps_chiming_when_closedidle_battery_drain/, June 2023)
Where to buy: HomeSmart · S$499 installed · stock unverified · checked 2026-10-23 · https://homesmart.sg/product/aqara-u100-smart-lock/
Buy timing: Consider only if giving up hands-free entry; target S$499 or less installed after fit and stock checks.
Reliability confidence: Limited — longer model history, but no dependable comparative failure-rate data.
